class.name: IfcStructuralLoadGroup
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: The entity IfcStructuralLoadGroup is used to structure the physical impacts. By using the grouping features inherited from IfcGroup , instances of IfcStructuralAction (or its subclasses) and of IfcStructuralLoadGroup can be used to define load groups, load cases and load combinations. (See also IfcLoadGroupTypeEnum .) NOTE: Important functionality for the description of a load

members.member: Selects a predefined type for the load group. It can be differentiated between load groups, load cases, load combinations, or userdefined grouping levels.
Type of actions in the group. Normally needed if 'PredefinedType' specifies a LOAD_CASE.
Source of actions in the group. Normally needed if 'PredefinedType' specifies a LOAD_CASE.
Load factor. If omitted, a factor is not yet known or not specified. A load factor of 1.0 shall be explicitly exported as Coefficient = 1.0.
Description of the purpose of this instance. Among else, possible values of the Purpose of load combinations are 'SLS', 'ULS', 'ALS' to indicate serviceability, ultimate, or accidental limit state.
